_what: THE INTAKE GATE. One entry per panel or table that supplies a VALUE. Filled BEFORE any digitiser was written.
_why: The two curations that took their values from a publisher Source Data file (NG_2025) and from the authors' own repository (WT_2026) have ZERO digitisation defects between them. The four that digitised have eight value-changing findings: F-006, F-008, F-017, F-018, F-019, F-020, F-033, F-040.

_tiers.1_publisher_source_data: a Source Data file published with the paper
_tiers.2_si_tables: an xlsx/csv/docx table in the supplementary information
_tiers.3_author_repository: the authors' own repo, Zenodo, Dryad, figshare
_tiers.4_pdf_text_table: a real text table inside the PDF (pdfplumber)
_tiers.5_pixels: digitised from a figure. THE LAST RESORT.

_rule: A panel recorded as 5_pixels MUST fill why_tiers_1_to_4_failed with a sentence a reviewer can check. 'Not available' is not such a sentence.

_exhaustion_evidence.tier_1: The Europe PMC REST record for PMID 40644303 lists no data-availability or source-data item, and the article has no 'Supporting Information' entry other than the one SI PDF. CHECKABLE: `curl .../europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=DOI:"10.1021/acsbiomaterials.5c00463"&resultType=core` -> hasSuppl=Y with exactly one supplement, NIHMS2133731-supplement-SI.pdf, which is the file in source/.
_exhaustion_evidence.tier_2: The SI has 28 pages and contains no xlsx/csv/docx. CHECKABLE: the only supplementary item in the JATS is `NIHMS2133731-supplement-SI.pdf`. Its structure is p1 TOC, p2 Figures S1-S2 (two rasters), p3 Figure S3 + S4 captions + the start of the NMR list, pp4-6 NMR peak lists, pp7-28 NMR spectra rasters.
_exhaustion_evidence.tier_3: find_repo.py run 2026-11-10 with --doi 10.1021/acsbiomaterials.5c00463 --pmid 40644303 --title 'Structure Activity Ionizable' --author Siegwart returned 0 candidate repositories; the 3 GitHub text hits are unrelated projects (an enzyme pH-optima repo, a packaging-foam page, and a different authors' JMP modelling repo).
_exhaustion_evidence.tier_4: The JATS XML has `table-wrap` count 0 -- the article contains no marked-up table at all. The SI DOES have one real text table (p3, Figure S3) and it is used, at tier 4, for every quantity it carries. It carries diameter, PDI, pKa and encapsulation efficiency; it carries NO luminescence and NO radiance, which is why the delivery endpoints fall to tier 5.

_also: Once the numbers are in hand from tiers 1-3, use the figure to VERIFY rather than to extract. Here there are no tiers 1-3 for any delivery endpoint, so the inverse was done: the tier-4 SI table (pKa and diameter for all 42 in-vivo lipids) is used to IDENTIFY the unlabelled points in Figures 4b and 5a, which then give two readings of the same 42 radiances that are independent of the bar charts.

panels.why_tiers_1_to_4_failed: There is no Source Data file (the JATS lists one supplementary item and it is the SI PDF), no author repository (find_repo.py, 0 hits), no SI table of any kind beyond the 42-row physical-characterisation table on SI p3, and the article's JATS has table-wrap count 0. `pymupdf` text extraction over all 28 SI pages returns no luminescence number anywhere: the only numbers in the SI text layer are diameters, PDIs, pKas, E.E. percentages and NMR shifts/integrals. So no tier 1-4 artefact contains these 465 values in any form.
panels.mitigation: The readout is DISCRETE (three legend swatches per cargo), which is the best case for a pixel read: nearest-neighbour against swatches sampled from this same raster, with heatmap.match raising above colour distance 5. It is not a continuous ramp, so there is no scale to get wrong -- only a grid, and the grid is checked against 465 independently-known library members.
panels.verified_against: All 465 (core, tail) pairs are present in the corpus as KZ_2016 (Zhou et al., PNAS 2016, PMID 26729861), the library this screen was drawn from. 15 cores x 31 tails = 465 exactly, and 465/465 match a KZ_2016 IL_name. That fixes the row order, the column order and the panel extent without using any colour.

panels.supplies: 465 siRNA knockdown values as a 3-level ordinal (0-25 / 25-70 / 70-100 % knockdown)
panels.why_not_emitted: This is not this paper's measurement. The main text says 'We analyzed the data from the prior siRNA screen and qualitatively classified...' -- i.e. the siRNA half is a RE-BINNING of reference 11 (Zhou et al., PNAS 2016, PMID 26729861), which is already in the corpus as KZ_2016 at 4 levels and 1,512 lipids. Emitting it would create a second Experiment_ID carrying the same laboratory's same measurements at coarser resolution, which is exactly the 'fabricate a lab' failure that kept XD_2026's LipidDB out. It IS read, and it is used as a check (see 07_qc.json, check Q6). Queued as D-2.

panels.used_for: The only check available on the ABSOLUTE scale of the radiances. R-squared is invariant to any affine rescaling of y, so it tests shape only; the SLOPE and INTERCEPT are in absolute radiance units, so a uniform multiplicative error in our y read would move both by the same factor and be visible. CLAUDE.md: passing printed statistics is necessary and not sufficient -- so the geometric checks (Q2, Q3) are the primary ones and this is corroboration.
